summary: Mr. Harari discusses the specific customs for Parshat Bamidbar and Parshat Nasso, focusing on the musical maqam and aliyot practices. He explains how the proximity of Shabuot influences the tunes used for Neshmat during Shabbat Kallah and details the varying traditions for the Kohen aliyah in both parashiyot.
questions: How does the proximity of Shabuot affect the tunes used for Neshmat?
What are the different ways to incorporate Shabuot tunes into the Neshmat?
How does the Kohen aliyah in Parshat Nasso differ between the Syrian community and Minhag Jerusalem?
What is the custom in Ades regarding the Kohen aliyah in Parshat Bamidbar?
